programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Ceaser deals with the fallout of his arrest, and what it means for the Brooklyn shop. Alex and Donna try to get their mojo back in the bedroom. Bae confronts a shocking diagnosis. And Sky embarks on a new venture.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Donna brings up people in Brooklyn talking trash about the upcoming Black Ink, which sets Ceaser off on a spiral through the past. Walt tries to make amends with Jessica. Sky embarks on a new business adventure. And Bae receives a welcome surprise.
programme.sub-title: Nice Day For A Shotgun Wedding

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: After missing for a couple of weeks, Ted comes clean to Ceaser and Puma about why he's been so absent. Mike finally receives his long-awaited paternity test results. Jessica brings her son Xavier to meet Walt. Mike has a medical emergency.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: The Brooklyn shop is finally open and Ceaser throws a block party to celebrate the grand opening. After Donna gives Alex an ultimatum, things don't go as expected. Crystal has a new jaw and a new attitude. Bae finds out Tati is hiding a big secret.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: After opening the Brooklyn shop, rumors swirl about the altercation between Crystal and Miss Kitty. Sky struggles with the future of her Miami shop. News that Tati is dating a new man causes issues for Ted. Puma courts Rich for a return to the shop.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: The crew heads to Cleveland for the first stop on Walt's comedy tour and to see Donna's hometown, but there are fireworks right off the bat. Alex finally meets Donna's dad and things don't go as planned.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Walt headlines his first comedy show tour in Cleveland. Kitty threatens to sue Ceaser while Alex tries to win Donna's dad over.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: When Sky announces a Black Ink Prom, the competition for who will be King and Queen gets fierce. Q works with Crystal to get Ceaser back. One of Donna's tattoo clients sends a threatening letter to the shop.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: The crew is still reeling from the disastrous prom when Ceaser's most prized possession turns up missing. He launches an investigation into the potential thief which leads to some surprising decisions. Sky's son Des tries to track down his mom.
programme.sub-title: The Problem With Torture Is Everybody Confesses

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: The news of Sky's suspension rocks the crew while Donna can't accept her apprentice demotion. Ceaser gets political and organizes a voter drive while Q faces a reckoning when his mom visits. Ceaser declares war on Ryan from 9MAG.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Ceaser fumes over the video with Ryan and Kitty and plots revenge. Donna attempts to get her job back. Bae gets set up by a matchmaker and finds an unlikely bond with Rok. Walt and Jess' engagement party goes wheels off.
programme.sub-title: Dogs are More Loyal than Kits

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: After a disastrous engagement party, Walt and Jess attend premarital counseling while the rest of the crew encourage Bae to face her biggest fear - confronting her abusive father.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Ceaser and the 113th crew travel to Philly for a tattoo convention and run into some frenemies. Jess has second thoughts about the wedding and Bae meets with her father one last time.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Ceaser fires his shot at Ryan and the two confront each other in a showdown. Relationship issues continue to worry Donna and Alex, while Walt has his own tale of woe. Ceaser receives news that could threaten the very existence of Black Ink New York.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Ceaser and the crew are still reeling from the news that the landlord wants them out of 113th in 30 days. Ceaser decides to do everything in his power to save the shop. Meanwhile, Donna has an uncomfortable chat with Tati, and Walt hits rock bottom.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Walt and Jess decide on a destination wedding but when nobody responds to their invite they reach out to other friends from their past. Ceaser continues to deal with the prospect of losing 113th and the crew discovers Ted might have a wife.
programme.sub-title: Niko's Going to Have a Cousin?

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: After an incriminating article puts 2nd City on blast, Charmaine and Kitty do damage control with their artists by burying the lede. As news travels quickly, the truth about the article threatens to ruin Charmaine's lavish NYC baby shower.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fills in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton), comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can effect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler into a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: Ryan, 25, is a sweet and sensitive man, whose alcohol addiction is spiraling out of control as he and his fiancee are expecting their first child in a matter of months.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: Anthony has been working at the pizzerias owned by his family since he was a kid. A good athlete, colleges offered him baseball scholarships. But at 14, everything changed.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: Adam, who began using heroin after his girlfriend broke up with him, panhandles money at gas stations to get enough money to score.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: John is a flight attendant who loves his job, but his lifestyle is fueling his alcoholism. When he was a boy, John's parents focused their attention on his mentally disabled brother.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: Amy and her family escaped the violence of apartheid-era South Africa and immigrated to Canada 22 years ago.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: Tressa's dreams were shattered when a routine drug test revealed that she had been living a double life as an Olympic hopeful and an IV drug user.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: A talented singer-songwriter, Bryceton's addiction to alcohol and spice (synthetic marijuana) is completely out of control.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: Identical twins Sonia and Julia, 22, shared everything as children and grew up in a loving home.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: A talented cellist and an aspiring music producer, Shane's musical aspirations are now out of reach because he abuses prescription drugs and deals drugs out of his grandmother's house.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: When he was three, Gabe's mother abandoned him on the streets of Calcutta, but he was adopted by a young American couple.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: Kelly, a 27-year-old mother of three, mixes pills and meth to forget the man behind bars who destroyed her childhood. Can Kelly's family come together to help her face the painful past that consumes her?

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: Alyson, a three-time White House intern and an award-winning student, met a boy in college who initiated her into drugs. She is addicted to morphine and crack and has returned to live with her parents.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: As the show celebrates its 10th anniversary, the cast and crew of the Emmy -award winning offers a behind-the-scenes perspective on what it takes.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: Suffering post-traumatic stress after being molested as a child, Mindie developed a drug habit in her teens that gave way to full-on meth addiction in her 20s.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: Adam was once one of top skiers in the United States.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: Friends and family gather to save two addicts--Rachel, once a beautiful child in an upper-middle class family who has turned to heroin and prostitution, and Tommy, who quit his executive job and sold his Lexus to sustain his cocaine habit.

programme.title: Intervention

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: The Millers: Walk-n-Wave
programme.desc: Worried that his mother has made him feel like he's better than other people, Nathan befriends a hopeless co-worker, Doug, who turns out to be a social outcast and more than Nathan knows how to handle.

programme.title: The Millers: Cancellation Fee
programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)
programme.desc: Carol begins her search for a new apartment, causing Nathan and Debbie to race each other to find her a place that is the farthest away from each of them.

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad
programme.desc: Tom and Carol decide to formally end their marriage but are surprised when they both hesitate to finalize the divorce, sending Nathan and Debbie into a panic at the thought of their parents reconciling.
programme.sub-title: Reunited and It Feels So Bad

programme.title: The Millers: Give Metta World Peace a Chance
programme.desc: Nathan lands the biggest interview of his career with professional basketball player Metta World Peace, but when karma catches up with him, he risks ruining his professional reputation.
programme.sub-title: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.title: The Millers: Diggin' Up Bones
programme.desc: In an attempt to get Carol to be more daring, Kip encourages her to confront her old Central Elementary School work nemesis, Miss Pam (Molly Shannon), at the teacher's retirement party.

programme.title: The Millers: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man
programme.desc: When Ray points out that Nathan has a history of being the worst wingman ever, Nathan embarks on a mission to be a better friend by becoming less self-involved.
programme.sub-title: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man

programme.title: The Millers: When The Pope Comes Marching In
programme.desc: When the Pope is scheduled to come to town, Nathan's planned week-long series of reports hits a snag when Ray gets a job offer to become the cameraman for a rival field reporter.
programme.sub-title: When The Pope Comes Marching In

programme.title: The Millers: Papa Was a Rolling Bone
programme.desc: The Millers decide to spend Thanksgiving apart for the first time ever, but they rethink the new family tradition when all their individual Turkey Day plans hit unexpected snags.

programme.title: The Millers: Louise Louise
programme.desc: When The Millers get a visit from their elderly Aunt Louise (Cloris Leachman), they rally to help her figure out what her legacy will be when she worries that she hasn't left her mark on the world yet.

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.title: The Millers: Hero
programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade
programme.desc: Nathan and Debbie trade parents when they each think the other sibling has it easier.

programme.title: The Millers: Plot Twists
programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.title: The Millers: The Mother Is In
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Françoise Desnoue Case
programme.desc: On the evening of August 30st 2013, in a small village of Bougrogne, Éric Desnoue, 52 years old, reports his wife missing to the police. Did Françoise Desnoue run away? Or did she reattempt to kill herself?

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: In Search of SK1 - Akira Ojima Case
programme.desc: On October 13th 1996, the body of young Angélique Dumetz, 18 years old, is recovered down a ditch in Oise forest. An important clue is found on the crime scene.
programme.sub-title: In Search of SK1 - Akira Ojima Case

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Death Trap On the Road (Schaaf Case)
programme.desc: A damaged bike belonging to Karine Schaaff, 16, is found abandoned by the side of a road in Moselle.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Jean-Raymond Blatti Case
programme.desc: Arriving at her work, the secretary of a small firm in the suburbs of Geneva finds the body of Jean-Raymond Blatti, the company's new accountant. The man is lying in a pool of blood and, on his belly, the murderer has written \"DIRTY RAPIST\".

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Two Accused of Murder (Jennifer Charron Case)
programme.desc: On Sunday, April 29, 2007, the body of Jennifer Charron, 21-years old, was found burnt to a crisp in a forest near Royan. The young waitress, who had been missing for two days, was visibly beaten and tied up.
programme.sub-title: Two Accused of Murder (Jennifer Charron Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Murder in Le Grand Bornand (Flactif case)
programme.desc: Xavier Flactif, his partner Graziella and their three children suddenly disappear. For several days, mystery reigns.

programme.title: Copycat Killers
programme.desc: Joe Post silences a rat in his gang, inspired by Goodfellas, after suspecting betrayal.

programme.title: Copycat Killers
programme.desc: Elena Lobacheva joins a group to kill homeless people, inspired by Bride of Chucky.

programme.title: Copycat Killers
programme.desc: Tony Bagnato and Diego Carbone get caught in drugs, murder, and a manhunt after joining a fight club

programme.title: Copycat Killers
programme.desc: James Roche and Holly Crawford, inspired by The Boondock Saints, kill to eliminate her lover's rival.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner: Derailed
programme.desc: A train passenger behaves oddly en route to Arizona and then disappears. The next day his bloodied body is found in Texas. Dr. G attempts to piece together this bizarre tragedy.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner: Broken Lives
programme.desc: Dr. G must figure out if a decomposed body is that of a local missing woman and if she was murdered.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner: Life Interrupted
programme.desc: During her career as a medical examiner, Dr. G has autopsied thousands of murder victims. In this episode, Dr. G shares her most memorable case.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner: Deadly Journey
programme.desc: Dr. G reviews a woman's medical records and learns that she suffered from an auto-immune disease called lupus, which might have something to do with her death.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner: Deadly Speeds
programme.desc: Motor vehicle fatalities account for many of the cases that come into the morgue. Dr. G offers expertise as to how to get behind the wheel and not wind up on a steel table.

programme.title: Conmen Case Files: Carl Hildebrandt – The Dead Con Artist
programme.desc: Hildebrandt faked his own death and stole the identity of a dead child to escape criminal charges before fleeing to Florida.
programme.sub-title: Carl Hildebrandt – The Dead Con Artist

programme.title: Conmen Case Files: Glenn Rycroft – The Cancer Con Artist
programme.desc: The former air steward who faked cancer and raised hundreds of thousands of dollars from his local community.
programme.sub-title: Glenn Rycroft – The Cancer Con Artist

programme.title: Conmen Case Files: John Myatt and John Drew – The Art World Con
programme.desc: The pair pulled off the biggest art con of the 20th Century, passing off works painted by Myatt as genuine works by famous artists.
programme.sub-title: John Myatt and John Drew – The Art World Con

programme.title: South Park: Bloody Mary
programme.desc: Bloody Mary: Randy is arrested for drunk driving and must attend AA, where he is told he is powerless to control himself. Maybe the bleeding Virgin Mary statue can perform a miracle or two? (S9, E14)

programme.title: South Park: The Return of Chef
programme.desc: The Return of Chef: The boys notice that Chef is acting weird after returning from the 'The Super Adventure Club'. Why is he trying to seduce them? Can a trip to a strip joint help? (S10, E01)

programme.title: South Park: Smug Alert!
programme.desc: Smug Alert: Kyle's father buys a new hybrid car but it's not long before his smug levels reach ridiculous levels - must be time to move to San Fran! How will Cartman deal with no Kyle? (S10, E02)

programme.title: South Park: A Million Little Fibers
programme.desc: A Million Little Fibers: Towlie writes his memoirs and it's not long before he's invited onto The Oprah Winfrey Show. (S10, E05)

programme.title: South Park: ManBearPig
programme.desc: ManBearPig: Ex U.S. Vice President Al Gore visits South Park Elementary and warns the pupils about ManBearPig, a monster which is "half man, half bear and half pig" - you can't be "cereal"! (S10, E06)

programme.title: South Park: Tsst!
programme.desc: Tsst: Cartman's mum realizes she can no longer control him, so attempts to get help from various reality TV experts. Only when she recruits the "Dog Whisperer" do results start to happen. (S10, E07)

programme.title: South Park: Make Love, Not Warcraft
programme.desc: Make Love, Not Warcraft: The boys are all shades of mad when a 'griefer' repeatedly kills them in an online game. Some serious training is in order so they can defeat him and play the game! (S10, E08)

programme.title: South Park: Mystery of the Urinal Deuce
programme.desc: Mystery of The Urinal Deuce: Someone defecates in a urinal at school! Cartman rants that it's a conspiracy "like 9/11!" The entire town think so too! Time for a trip to the White House. (S10, E09)

programme.title: South Park: Hotter than Summer: Miss Teacher Bangs a Boy
programme.desc: Miss Teacher Bangs A Boy: Power goes to Cartman's head when he becomes "Dawg the Hallway Monitor". Meanwhile, Kyle is shocked to discover his little brother Ike and his teacher are at "it"! (S10, E10)
programme.sub-title: Hotter than Summer: Miss Teacher Bangs a Boy

programme.title: South Park: Hell on Earth 2006
programme.desc: Hell On Earth 2006: Satan has a Sweet 16 style party in L.A. on Halloween! The gang perform a ritual and manage to summon Biggie Smalls - who demands Butters helps him get to the party! (S10, E11)

programme.title: South Park: Go God Go (Part 1)
programme.desc: Go God Go (1): Cartman is impatient to get his hands on the latest games console. Result? A visit to the atheistic future of 2546! Richard Dawkins pays a visit to South Park Elementary. (S10, E12)

programme.title: South Park: Go God Go XII (Part 2)
programme.desc: Go God Go XII (2): Cartman is stuck in the future, caught up in a battle between atheists and sea otters! And what will become of Richard Dawkins and Mrs. Garrison's love affair? (S10, E13)

programme.title: South Park: Stanley's Cup
programme.desc: Stanley's Cup: In a parody of underdog sports films, Stan is sentenced to community service and ends up coaching the Park County Pee-Wee hockey team - can he turn these losers into winners? (S10, E14)

programme.title: South Park: With Apologies to Jesse Jackson
programme.desc: With Apologies to Jessie Jackson: Randy faces public ridicule for using the "N" word on live TV. Cartman can't resist teasing a little person who comes to school to teach about prejudice. (S11, E01)

programme.title: South Park: Hotter Than Summer: Cartman Sucks
programme.desc: Cartman Sucks: After being caught in a compromising position with Eric, Butters is sent to a special camp to "Pray the Gay Away". Cartman tries to retrieve the incriminating photo. (S11, E02)

programme.title: South Park: Lice Capades
programme.desc: Lice Capades: Eric tries to discover the source of an outbreak of lice at the school. The lice are living peacefully in a village until they see the school nurse staring at them! (S11, E03)

programme.title: South Park: The Snuke
programme.desc: The Snuke: The citizens of South Park are gearing up for the arrival of Hillary Clinton. Eric suspects that a new student is planning a terrorist attack but the real culprits are deadlier. (S11, E04)

programme.title: South Park: Fantastic Easter Special
programme.desc: Fantastic Easter Special: Stan sets out to find a reason for painting Easter eggs and discovers his father is part of a society called "The Hare Club For Men", but all is not what it seems. (S11, E05)

programme.title: South Park: D-Yikes!
programme.desc: D-Yikes!: Ms. Garrison decides that she is a lesbian after getting dumped again but hell breaks loose when her new favourite lesbian bar faces a takeover from Persians in a '300' stylee. (S11, E06)

programme.desc: Wong Fei-Hung y su amigo Chung llegan a Pekín para un concurso de Danza del León. Wong enfrenta a un rival romántico y a un rival en artes marciales, ambos desafían sus habilidades.

programme.title: Crónicas Mutantes
programme.desc: En el siglo XXIII, el mayor Mitch Hunter (Jane) lidera una lucha contra un ejército de necromutantes que habitan en el mundo subterráneo.

programme.title: In Time
programme.desc: En un futuro en que la gente deja de envejecer a los 25 años, el dinero puede comprar la juventud inmortal.

programme.title: Yo, Frankenstein
programme.desc: La criatura de Frankenstein se encuentra atrapada en una guerra total de siglos de antigüedad entre dos clanes inmortales.

programme.title: Programa AND
programme.desc: Cuando un humilde cartero es incluido en un programa de ADN sobrehumano ultrasecreto en un centro de investigación, se revela que podrá recibir, controlar y enviar información basada en los sentidos de los demás.

programme.title: Elektra
programme.desc: Elektra tras recuperarse de las mortales heridas sufridas en "Daredevil", se convierte en la más peligrosa asesina del mundo.

programme.title: In Time
programme.desc: En un futuro en que la gente deja de envejecer a los 25 años, el dinero puede comprar la juventud inmortal.
El viaje de un hombre al futuro para salvar un mundo moribundo.

programme.title: Hielo
programme.desc: Inexplicablemente en pleno verano, el hielo se apodera de la ciudad de Los Ángeles y sus habitantes están muriendo ya que la temperatura es muy por debajo a lo que están acostumbrados. La única manera de sobrevivir es ir hacia las playas de Long Beach.

programme.title: Snake
programme.desc: Un profesor de biología que intenta salvar a su hija enferma con una cura natural se adentra en la jungla con expertos y encuentra un horror que es más grande que la vida.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando un adolescente talentoso realiza una gira de fantasmas en Missouri, una entidad malvada lo sigue a casa. ¡Y cuando llegue las cosas al siguiente nivel, se dará cuenta de que necesitan ayuda y rápido!

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando Jennifer Patterson encuentra la casa de sus sueños en la zona rural de Indiana, está más que emocionada. Pronto, voces y aromas inexplicables la llevan a creer que la casa está encantada por el fantasma del dueño anterior.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Después de mudarse a una nueva casa, los Barbour se preocupan por el efecto negativo que un amigo imaginario está teniendo en su hija. Pronto se hace evidente que están lidiando con un fantasma enojado.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Un hogar es invadido por un demonio empeñado en lastimar a los miembros de la familia uno por uno.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando Jacinda Rearick encuentra orbes en sus fotos, cree que son espíritus amistosos. Pero cuando una entidad oscura comienza a atormentar a su familia, se da cuenta de que están lidiando con el mal.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Después de que Candace y John St. Clair exploran un túnel encantado con una historia espantosa, un invitado no invitado los sigue a casa.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una pareja se muda a una casa con una historia trágica y pronto cree que su casa está encantada. Después de varios ataques, piden ayuda a investigadores paranormales.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Después de que un amenazador soldado nazi busca venganza por su muerte y amenaza a una pareja inocente, buscan ayuda para hacer las paces con su fantasma.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una mujer cree que su difunto esposo está rondando su hogar hasta que su hija es atacada por una entidad maligna.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Después de su divorcio, Al se encontró con la necesidad de un nuevo comienzo y hogar. Lo que encontró fue algo para lo que nunca podría haberse preparado.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Después de que una hermosa adolescente atrae la atención de una presencia desconocida, se convierte en el objetivo de sus avances, causando estragos en su vida y en la de su familia.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: El fantasma de un adolescente atormentado rompe la serenidad de una familia joven poco después de mudarse a su primera casa.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una familia cree que tiene un fantasma inofensivo en su casa hasta que comienza a amenazar a los niños. No queriendo dejar que el mal gane, la familia recurre a la Iglesia Católica para expulsar al demonio.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una madre y una hija saben que su casa está encantada. Pero mientras la madre cree que es el espíritu de su novio asesinado, su hija cree que es mucho más oscuro.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: El fantasma de un adolescente atormentado rompe la serenidad de una familia joven poco después de mudarse a su primera casa.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Angela, una recién casada, está emocionada de comenzar su nueva vida con Stephen cuando las pesadillas recurrentes que experimentó cuando era niña resurgen repentinamente. Pronto, la vieja y amenazadora bruja de sus sueños invade sus horas de vigilia.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Todo parece ir por buen camino cuando Sidney traslada a su novia embarazada a la casa que comparte con su madre. Pero su felicidad se rompe repentinamente cuando la familia comienza a experimentar eventos perturbadores.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Carl Johnson comienza a usar un tablero espiritual con sus hermanos, Keith y Cynthia, para comunicarse con el espíritu que acecha su hogar.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando el esposo bombero de Jeanette muere en el cumplimiento del deber, ella recurre a su indomable espíritu neoyorquino y traslada a sus hijas a una aldea rústica en Long Island para comenzar de nuevo. Pero su refugio rural resulta todo menos idílico.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Joy, una madre trabajadora de tres hijos, asume que el fin de semana de una niña en una plantación encantada será un cambio de ritmo agradable.

programme.title: La Virgen Morena
programme.desc: En 1531 el príncipe Azteca Temoc, hijo de Cuauhtémoc, secuestra a Blanca, la hija del virrey, como venganza de los abusos cometidos por los hombres blanco, principalmente por el capitán Delgadillo, que asesina despiadadamente a los indios.

programme.title: Las Cariñosas
programme.desc: Laura, Lola y Carmen son tres mujeres muy guapas y enfermeras de un sanatorio, que provocan que los enfermos del sexo masculino se enfermen más, para que estas bellas jóvenes sigan atendiéndoles.

programme.title: Los Barbaros Del Norte
programme.desc: Olivia Fullet, va en busca de su hermano Antonio quien según esta a punto de llegar en su barco a la playa proveniente de Panama junto con su amigo Pierre. Antes de llegar, su pequeño barco se estrella en las rocas, quedando un solo sobreviviente.

programme.title: Me Gustan Todas
programme.desc: Tras recibir el consejo de su doctor de cabecera, Don Nicanor, un adinerado hombre de nacionalidad mexicana, decide ir en busca de su hija perdida Rosita, quien radica en la Habana, Cuba. Decide contratar a dos agentes para que den con su paradero.

programme.title: Mis Tres Viudas Alegres
programme.desc: México, años 50. En plena noche de bodas con su esposa Silvia, el viejo sabio José se muere. Aparecen otras viudas suyas, la cubana Amalia y la francesa Lilia. El les deja 60 millones de pesos a estas a cambio de que encuentren a un hijo.

programme.title: Piernas De Oro
programme.desc: En una carrera de bicicletas, Clavillazo vence a Esteban quien siempre había sido el campeón municipal. El coronel García ordena que formen una cuarteta con Clavillazo. Esteban y otros, para correr en la vuelta al centro de la república.

programme.title: Platillos Voladores
programme.desc: Marciano y Saturnina, van a un baile de disfraces con trajes interplanetarios. Al producirse una pelea entre el joven y un pretendiente de la muchacha a quien apoya su padre, la pareja escapa en un artefacto inventado por Marciano que es mecánico.

programme.title: Pobre Huerfanita
programme.desc: Virginia es una niña que lo tiene todo en la vida, menos el cariño de su padre que por tener tanto dinero se la viven de fiesta en fiesta, por lo que le brindan muy poco a casi nada de atención quedando siempre al cuidado de una institutriz.

programme.title: Que Hombre Tan Sin Embargo
programme.desc: Filomeno, es un hombre que llega a casa de Laura cuando mas lo necesita. El es un simple desconocido para Laura y su familia adinerada y de prestigio que por el momento pasa por una crisis financiera, ya que la industria de la sal estan en quiebra.

programme.title: Que Lindo Cha Cha Cha
programme.desc: El diablo, molesto porque Don Candido, el presidente municipal de un pueblo esta moralizando las costumbres del pueblo que gobierna, envia a uno de sus subordinados a la tierra para corromper el ambiente mediante la organizacion de un cabaret.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El pueblo se entera de que los milagros de Jesús se realizaron cuando estaba drogado y todos estan decepcionados de el por lo que quieren liberarse de sus Scausas (Pulseras).

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Obama vuelve a ganar las elecciones, pero al parecer, fue con la ayuda de Cartman en complicidad con el gobierno chino.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se infiltra en la Agencia de Seguridad Nacional porque cree que lo están espiando, y no le gusta lo que encuentra en su expediente personal.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los adultos de la ciudad están obsesionados con los programas de homicidios de la tv, por lo cual los niños deciden bloquear esos canales.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman teme que Token y otros afroamericanos comiencen un apocalipsis zombi al estilo Guerra Mundial Z, la película de Brad Pitt. Así que corre por todo South Park para poner fin a esta amenaza.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Henrietta, la chica gótica, es enviada a un campamento para niños con problemas emocionales. Cuando regresa, sus amigos descubren que se convirtió en una chica Emo.
programme.sub-title: Chicos Góticos 3: El Origen de los Pretenciosos

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Ike llega la pubertad y comienza a distanciarse de Kyle. Para salvar la relación con su hermano, Kyle decide llevar a Ike a ver una presentación en vivo de su programa de televisión favorito.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman ha logrado “la paz mundial” gracias a una de sus bromas para humillar a Kyle. Este acontecimiento reúne a miles de líderes religiosos de todo el mundo en South Park.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos se preparan para luchar contra las multitudes que hacen la cola en el primer día oficial de las compras navideñas.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La traición de la “Princesa Kenny” dejó a Cartman loco por venganza y los niños se preparan para una batalla épica en donde sólo una plataforma de videojuegos será la ganadora.
programme.sub-title: Una canción De culo y fuego

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Las puertas del centro comercial abrirán finalmente para la mayor venta del Black Friday de la historia.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Wendy se mete en problemas al intentar demostrar que sin la ayuda de Photoshop, Kim Kardashian se parecería a un hobbit. Su prometido, Kanye "Pez Gay" West sale a defenderla.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos deciden crear una empresa financiada con micro donaciones masivas a través de internet para alejarse de sus estudios y comenzar una nueva vida en la cual no deban hacer nada.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos vuelven a la escuela, pero ahora todos los demás estudiantes los odian. Mientras, el consejero Mackey deja su adicción al gluten y comienza a decir lo bien que se siente.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se hace pasar por transexual para poder usar el baño de las niñas en la escuela. Mientras tanto, Randy lleva una doble vida, consiguiendo fama como la famosa cantante adolescente Lorde.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Timmy lanza un servicio llamado “Handicar”, que se convierte en el medio de transporte más exitoso de South Park. Sin embargo, como resultado, Timmy gana muchos enemigos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman y Butters miran con asombro un dron y no logran resistir la tentación de maniobrarlo por la ciudad, invadiendo la privacidad de todos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan se vuelve adicto al nuevo juego móvil de Terrance y Phillip intenta convencer a sus amigos de que es el mejor juego de todos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman le juega una broma a Butters haciéndole creer que está usando un casco de realidad virtual. Butters comienza a causar estragos, ya que no logra distinguir la diferencia entre real y virtual.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kenny es un excelente jugador de “Magic: The Gathering” por lo que comienza a ser el centro de atención. Mientras tanto, Wendy decide pasar más tiempo con Stan y ver qué es lo que hace.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle quiere jugar a los videojuegos con su hermano menor. Pero cuando Ike no quiere jugar más con él, Kyle teme que la próxima generación lo haya superado.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El show de Cartman es tendencia, mientras que el país se prepara para vivir la fiesta mas espectacular jamás vista.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El Sr. Mackey hace una convocatoria a los padres y estudiantes de la primaria de South Park para anunciar que la directora Victoria ha sido despedida, siendo reemplazada por el director PC.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La ciudad de South Park está en crisis y Kenny piensa que es hora de conseguir un trabajo.
programme.sub-title: La ciudad que es parte del pueblo

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se considera el crítico número uno en Internet de restaurantes en South Park.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Por su imagen corporal, Cartman es la víctima más reciente de bullying.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Las niñas asiáticas de la escuela están dibujando imágenes románticas al estilo manga de Tweek y Craig, creando una gran confusión entre los alumnos y los padres.

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Una apuesta iniciada porque Cartman vio a un duende es el inicio de un problema, aunado a que los chicos se encuentran frente a la totalidad imaginativa del mundo atacada por un grupo terrorista.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se considera el crítico número uno en Internet de restaurantes en South Park.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos intentan cruzar al elefante de Kyle con ''Fofa'', la cerda de Cartman, para un experimento genético de la escuela con el cual intentan ganarle a Terrance. Mientras, Stan lucha contra los abusos físicos de su hermana, Shelly.
programme.sub-title: Un elefante hace el amor con una cerda

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman consigue ganar dinero subiendo videos de unos bebés peleando por una pelotita de crack. Kyle piensa que eso es malo hasta que Cartman lo convence de que no es así.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman le insiste a sus amigos que los ataques terroristas del 11 de Septiembre fueron una conspiración y se dispone a desenmascarar la verdad. Por su parte, el Sr. Mackey quiere saber quién defecó en el baño.
programme.sub-title: El misterio del mojón en el urinal

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El Señor Garrison ha decidido hacerse un cambio de sexo y ahora se siente como una verdadera mujer. Mientras tanto, Kyle quiere hacerse una cirugía para ser negro y poder jugar en el equipo de básquetbol.
programme.sub-title: La nueva vagina del Señor Garrison

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Un día de diversión en el parque acuático se torna mortal para los niños.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Nueva Jersey se está expandiendo rápidamente y South Park está en peligro de convertirse en la siguiente ciudad en ser invadida. Randy y los chicos intentarán evitarlo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Una nueva alumna llega a la escuela primaria de South Park y es negra por lo que Cartman cree que debería hacer pareja con Token, y no dejará que nadie se interponga en el camino, en especial Kyle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos encuentran un antiguo objeto triangular en una excavación escolar. Luego de salir en el noticiero, Barbra Streisand aparece buscándolo ya que es lo que necesita para poder convertirse en un monstruo gigante japonés.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle está muy enfermo y su madre trata de curarlo con medicinas naturales de una curandera y sus colaboradores "nativos americanos”. Mientras, el señor Garrison es despedido y se convierte en un escritor de novelas románticas.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Randy propone un plan para arreglar la situación económica mundial. Mientras tanto, Stan intenta devolver una máquina para hacer margaritas, y un salvador inesperado hace el último sacrificio para resolver los problemas de todos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: En "Imaginaciónlandia", Stan y Butters luchan contra un ejército de fuerzas imaginarias. La Suprema Corte declara que las criaturas imaginarias no son reales y planean destruir "Imaginaciónlandia".

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La última de las pruebas científicas revela que algunos de los chicos de South Park tiene un problema de adicción al sexo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle firma un contrato con la empresa Apple sin leerlo previamente. Mientras tanto, Cartman enloquece a su mamá porque ésta no le compro un iPad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El primo de Kyle, también llamado Kyle, llega de visita desde Connecticut, ya que su madre está enferma. A pesar de ser de la misma edad, los primos no tienen nada en común.

programme.title: Birdman o (La inesperada virtud de la ignorancia)
programme.desc: Riggan Thompson saltó a la fama tras interpretar a un célebre superhéroe. Ahora, trata de darle un giro a su carrera interpretativa que reafirme su prestigio profesional montando una obra de teatro en Broadway.

programme.title: Moby Dick
programme.desc: El Pequod es un barco ballenero cuyo objetivo principal es cazar a la mítica ballena blanca. Al mando de la nave está el tiránico capitán Ahab, que vive obsesionado con la idea de capturar al animal que consiguió escapar después de arrancarle una pierna.

programme.title: Transsiberian
programme.desc: Tras una temporada en Pekín, Roy y Jessie deciden viajar a Moscú en el Transiberiano, el ferrocarril que une la Rusia europea con las provincias rusas del Lejano Oriente.

programme.title: Réquiem Por Un Sueño
programme.desc: Cuatro personas luchan contra drogadicciones cada vez más insaciables, y a pesar de sus buenas intenciones, las drogas ganan y sus vidas entran en una espiral sin control.

programme.title: Sin rastro (Gone)
programme.desc: La policía no la cree, así que una mujer (Amanda Seyfried) emprende en solitario la búsqueda del asesino en serie del que escapó en el pasado y que ahora cree que ha secuestrado a su hermana.

programme.title: Arturo y Merlín: Caballeros de Camelot
programme.desc: El rey Arturo regresa tras la guerra y descubre que su hijo ilegítimo ha usurpado el trono de Camelot, por lo que deberá reunirse con Merlín y los Caballeros de la Mesa Redonda para recuperarlo.

programme.title: Ir a perderlo y perderse
programme.desc: En 1965, cuatro adolescentes viajan a Tijuana para pasar una noche de fiesta, cuando se les une un ama de casa con el corazón roto que está en la ciudad buscando un rápido divorcio.

programme.title: Albert Nobbs
programme.desc: Irlanda, siglo XIX. Una mujer (Glenn Close) se disfraza de hombre para poder trabajar y sobrevivir. El film obtuvo 3 nominaciones a los Oscar, 2011.

programme.title: Resistencia
programme.desc: Bielorrusia, 1941. Tres hermanos judíos logran escapar de una muerte segura y se refugian en los bosques, que conocen desde su infancia. Protagonizada por Daniel Craig (Casino Royale) y dirigida por Edward Zwick (Diamante de sangre).

programme.title: Las nuevas aventuras de Aladino
programme.desc: Dos empleados fracasados de unos grandes almacenes planean robar la tienda tras el cierre. Pero cuando un grupo de niños aparece pidiendo una historia, los hombres improvisan y empiezan a contar su propia versión del cuento de Aladino.

programme.title: Tracers
programme.desc: Thriller de acción que gira en torno a Cam (Taylor Lautner, Sin salida (Abduction), La saga Crepúsculo: Amanecer - Parte 2), un mensajero que recorre las calles de la moderna New York montado en bicicleta.

programme.title: 12 balas
programme.desc: Dean Ambrose, la superestrella de la WWE, hace de Shaw, un detective que vuelve al servicio activo tras la muerte de su compañero. Cuando descubre pruebas que relacionan a sus compañeros con un asesinato, le incriminan en un homicidio que no cometió.

programme.title: Rompiendo las reglas
programme.desc: Un adolescente rebelde ingresa a una nueva escuela, donde se ve envuelto en la escena de la lucha clandestina.

programme.title: El jaguar
programme.desc: Tres pintorescos personajes coinciden en el ascensor del gran hotel Crillon: un indio amazónico, su intérprete y un ciudadano francés, cuya vida cambia cuando el nativo lo reconoce como El Elegido.

programme.title: El archivo corso
programme.desc: Un notario de provincias le encarga un caso aparentemente sencillo: encontrar a Ange Leoni, un hombre corso que ha heredado unas propiedades. Pero, nada más llegar a Córcega, Jack se da cuenta de que el caso es más complicado de lo que había pensado.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: James Hunt y Niki Lauda, dos pilotos de Fórmula 1 extremadamente hábiles, mantienen entre sí una intensa rivalidad. Sin embargo, es su enemistad lo que les lleva al límite.

programme.title: Valentine: venganza oscura
programme.desc: Una joven se involucra con un hombre con la idea de que va a hacer una película cuando lo que él pretende es convertirla en vigilante enmascarada.

programme.title: El archivo corso
programme.desc: Un notario de provincias le encarga un caso aparentemente sencillo: encontrar a Ange Leoni, un hombre corso que ha heredado unas propiedades. Pero, nada más llegar a Córcega, Jack se da cuenta de que el caso es más complicado de lo que había pensado.

programme.title: Entrega especial
programme.desc: Una mujer que se dedica a la mensajería especial recibe el más insólito encargo: deberá recoger a una adolescente rebelde en el domicilio paterno situado en China y entregarla a su madre en Occidente.

programme.title: La boda de Rosa
programme.desc: A punto de cumplir 45 años, Rosa se da cuenta de que siempre ha vivido su vida para servir a los demás, por lo que decide dejarlo todo atrás, tomar las riendas de su vida y cumplir su sueño de emprender su propio negocio.

programme.title: Mi casa en París
programme.desc: Mathias, un desventurado neoyorquino sin esposa, sin hijos y sin un céntimo, hereda de su padre, con quien no se hablaba, una enorme en casa en París, de la que quiere deshacerse lo antes posible.

programme.title: Aprendiz de gigoló
programme.desc: Un hombre convence a su amigo para trabajar como gigoló, lo que provoca situaciones cómicas y complicadas.

programme.title: Dance-Off
programme.desc: Brandon y Jasmine son dos bailarines pertenecientes a academias rivales que deben competir por un gran premio. En su viaje a la final el enfrentamiento se va convirtiendo en amor.

programme.title: Querida Elisabeth
programme.desc: La vida de Sid Straw se desmorona a medida que trata de demostrar a sus amigos que entabló amistad con una celebridad mientras estaba en la universidad.

programme.title: Tras la pista del zorro
programme.desc: Aldo Vanucci (Peter Sellers), también conocido como "el Zorro", es un ingenioso y brillante ladrón. A lo largo de su agitada carrera, se ha hecho pasar por los más variados personajes, desde sacerdote a carabinero.

programme.title: Red Dog, una historia de lealtad
programme.desc: Basada en una historia real, la película cuenta cómo un perro recorre Australia creando vínculos con los habitantes de un pueblo minero, convirtiéndose en un símbolo de amistad y lealtad.

programme.title: Primavera en Normandía
programme.desc: Un panadero observa cómo su vecina repite sin saberlo la historia de Madame Bovary.

programme.title: Resistencia
programme.desc: Bielorrusia, 1941. Tres hermanos judíos logran escapar de una muerte segura y se refugian en los bosques, que conocen desde su infancia. Protagonizada por Daniel Craig (Casino Royale) y dirigida por Edward Zwick (Diamante de sangre).

programme.title: Hojas de hierba
programme.desc: Las vidas de dos gemelos dan un giro cuando el primero, un profesor de filosofía, es confundido por el segundo, un traficante de drogas al que varios clanes del narcotráfico quieren ver muerto.

programme.title: El duodécimo hombre
programme.desc: En 1943, en la Noruega ocupada por Alemania, un grupo de saboteadores es traicionado y apresado por las tropas nazis. De los 12 integrantes del comando, sólo uno consigue sobrevivir.

programme.title: Acero azul
programme.desc: Una novata del cuerpo de policía se ve envuelta en un juego del gato y el ratón con un psicópata con una pistola que se obsesiona con ella.

programme.title: Straw Dogs
programme.desc: El astrofísico americano David Sumner (Hoffman) se traslada a vivir al pueblo de su mujer, en Gran Bretaña.

programme.title: Amenazados
programme.desc: Thriller psicológico que gira en torno al interrogatorio, por parte de un agente del FBI, a un sospechoso de terrorismo para que confiese la ubicación de tres bombas nucleares preparadas para detonar en los Estados Unidos.

programme.title: Sin rastro (Gone)
programme.desc: La policía no la cree, así que una mujer (Amanda Seyfried) emprende en solitario la búsqueda del asesino en serie del que escapó en el pasado y que ahora cree que ha secuestrado a su hermana.

programme.title: El intruso
programme.desc: Tras un trágico accidente, un hombre se convierte en el objetivo de la peligrosa obsesión de otro testigo.

programme.title: Mentira de familias
programme.desc: Después de que sus padres murieran en lo que parece un accidente de coche, Emily y sus hermanos menores se mudan a un pequeño pueblo de Luisiana. Pronto comienzan a suceder cosas extrañas, dando a los hermanos la sensación de que están siendo observados.

programme.title: Pacific Blue: Visiones
programme.desc: Mientras trabaja con un haitiano del que sospechan que está traficando drogas, Bobby ve a un hombre al que arrestó hace unos años y que todavía está en prisión

programme.title: Pacific Blue: El Pueblo Fantasma
programme.desc: Jamie se encuentra con una cantante desmayada y la lleva a casa. Cuando vuelve en sí, coge la pistola de Jamie. Éste la encuentra en casa de su madre. Ella le cuenta que está deprimida por su productor discográfico.

programme.title: Pacific Blue: Candidato a la Lista de Muertos
programme.desc: Abogado demanda a la policía por muerte por negligencia. Anuncia un testigo clave, pero es atacado. Cory descubre un arma con su asistente. El testigo es un engaño. El verdadero testigo es atacado, revelando la verdad.
programme.sub-title: Candidato a la Lista de Muertos

programme.title: Pacific Blue: Tribunal Popular
programme.desc: Jennie, la hermana de Jamie, regresa a Santa Mónica, pero es secuestrada por jóvenes. El chico con el que Jamie está saliendo está de alguna manera involucrado, también el sucio detective antinarcóticos Perry Marcus.

programme.title: Pacific Blue: Mil Palabras
programme.desc: Russ y Cory se infiltran en el feo y violento mundo de los nazis, tratando de atrapar a los asesinos de varios jóvenes. Jamie actúa de incógnito e intenta proteger a un joven, un fotógrafo talentoso, que ha captado un encuentro entre dos adversarios.

programme.title: Pacific Blue: Visión Doble
programme.desc: Una presentadora es testigo de un asesinato y T.C. le salva la vida. T.C. ciega a la mujer. T.C. se obsesiona con protegerla debido a su culpa y su parecido con el amor de su vida.. La mujer no sabe que fue él quien la cegó, creando una historia de amor.

programme.title: Pacific Blue: Cincuenta Y Nueve Minutos
programme.desc: Cuando una chica es secuestrada en el estacionamiento de un centro comercial, Cory y la unidad deben unirse para encontrarla en 59 minutos. Los oficiales deben lidiar con la madre histérica y las pistas falsas antes de que terminen los 59 minutos.

programme.title: Pacific Blue: Traición

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 9

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: STEVEN SPIELBERG and GEORGE LUCAS bring you the greatest adventurer of all time! Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull finds Indy trying to outrace a brilliant and beautiful agent for the mystical, all-powerful crystal skull of Akator.

programme.title: Enemy at the Gates
programme.desc: Vassili is a young Russian sharpshooter who becomes a legend when a savvy political officer makes him the hero of his propaganda campaign. Their friendship is threatened when both men fall in love with a beautiful female soldier. As the battle for the city rages, Vassili faces the ultimate challenge when the Nazi command dispatches its most elite marksman to hunt down and kill the man who has become the hope of all Russia.

programme.title: Sands of Iwo Jima
programme.desc: Marine Sgt. John Stryker (John Wayne) is despised by his own men for his rough attitude and exhausting training regimen. As the war in the Pacific progresses, though, they begin to respect Stryker's hard-edged outlook on war and his brutal training methods, as it has helped them prepare for the harsh realities of the battlefield. They'll need all of Stryker's battle tactics if they want to survive what will end up being one of the bloodiest engagements of the war: the Battle of Iwo Jima.

programme.title: Universal Soldier
programme.desc: During the Vietnam War, soldier Luc Devereaux (Jean-Claude Van Damme) finds that his superior officer, Andrew Scott (Dolph Lundgren), has turned violently deranged, and the two fight to the death. After their bodies are retrieved, they are placed into a secret program in which they are reanimated and trained to become unquestioning killing machines. While Devereaux and Scott initially have no memory of their former lives, glimpses of their pasts start to return, rekindling their intense conflict.

programme.title: We Were Soldiers
programme.desc: Based upon the best-selling book "We Were Soldiers Once ... and Young" by Lt. Gen. Harold G. Moore (Ret.) and journalist Joseph L. Galloway, this compelling war drama depicts the true story of the first major battle between the United States and North Vietnamese forces. It is a film about uncommon valor and nobility under fire, loyalty among soldiers, and the heroism and sacrifice of men and women both home and abroad.

programme.title: Catch And Release
programme.desc: After the sudden death of her fiancé, Gray Wheeler finds comfort in the company of his friends.

programme.title: Man Of The House
programme.desc: A Texas Ranger is forced to go undercover to protect a group of cheerleaders after they witness a murder.

programme.title: Last Action Hero
programme.desc: A magic movie ticket, transports a young fan into the ficitional world of his favorite action movie character.

programme.title: Close Encounters Of The Third Kind (Director's Cut)
programme.desc: A line worker, after an encounter with UFO s, feels drawn to an isolated area in the wilderness.

programme.title: Bell, Book and Candle
programme.desc: In the late 1950s, Gillian Holroyd (Kim Novak) is a modern-day witch living in New York City's Greenwich Village. When she encounters charming publisher Shepherd Henderson (James Stewart), she decides to make him hers by casting a love spell. Gillian takes added pleasure in doing so because Henderson is engaged to her old college rival (Janice Rule). However, Gillian finds herself actually falling for Shepherd, which poses a problem: She will lose her powers if she falls in love.

programme.title: A Raisin in the Sun
programme.desc: This lauded drama follows the Youngers, an African-American family living together in an apartment in Chicago. Following the death of their patriarch, they try to determine what to do with the substantial insurance payment they'll soon receive. Opinions on what to do with the money vary. Walter Lee (Sidney Poitier) wants to make a business investment, while his mother, Lena (Claudia McNeil), is intent on buying a house for them all to live in -- two differing views of the American Dream.

programme.title: In Cold Blood
programme.desc: In this adaptation of Truman Capote's seminal true-crime novel, ex-convicts Perry Smith (Robert Blake) and Richard Dick Hickock (Scott Wilson) hatch a plan to rob a wealthy Kansas family, the Clutters. The men enter the Clutter home expecting to find a safe filled with cash, but in fact find no money at all. Enraged, they kill the entire family and flee. While on the run, they face not only the realities of their terrible crime but also their own earthly impermanence.

programme.title: The Caine Mutiny
programme.desc: During World War II, a dilapidated vessel, the Caine, gets a new ensign, Willis Keith (Robert Francis), and a new captain, Commander Queeg (Humphrey Bogart). The crew sees Queeg's unconventional behavior as irrational, and communications officer Thomas Keefer (Fred MacMurray) spreads suspicion about his suitability as captain. When a dire situation during a storm forces the executive officer (Van Johnson) to relieve Queeg of his duties, he and Ensign Keith are tried for mutiny.

programme.title: Mission
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt, a secret agent, is framed for the deaths of his espionage team and attempts to flee government assassins after him. He races against the clock in order to discover the truth.

programme.title: Mission
programme.desc: The world's greatest spy, Ethan Hunt, returns and partners up with the beautiful Nyah Hall to stop renegade agent Sean Ambrose from releasing a new kind of terror on an unsuspecting world.

programme.title: Mission
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt hurdles into spectacular new adventures from Rome to Shanghai as he races to rescue a captured agent and stop Davian from eliminating his next target, Ethan's wife.

programme.title: Assault on Precinct 13
programme.desc: While en route to prison, a bus carrying criminals Marion (Laurence Fishburne), Beck (John Leguizamo) and Anna (Aisha Hinds) is rerouted to Detroit's soon-to-be-closed Precinct 13 because of a dangerous winter storm. All communications with the outside world are cut off, and Jake (Ethan Hawke), an emotionally volatile police sergeant who is haunted by his past, is forced to work with the criminals in order to survive an attack on the precinct by a group of armed men.

programme.title: Black Dog
programme.desc: An ex-con takes a job truck driving across the country. However, the truck is filled with illegal weapons, and now he must fight to save his family. The stakes are high as gun runners, government agents and a fleet of monstrous 18-wheelers pursue him in an intense highway duel.

programme.title: Lowriders
programme.desc: A teenage graffiti artist paints murals on the hoods of lowrider cars to help his older brother win an upcoming competition.

programme.title: Death Race: Beyond Anarchy
programme.desc: Black ops specialist Connor Gibson infiltrates a maximum security prison to take down legendary driver Frankenstein in a violent and brutal car race.

programme.title: 2 Fast 2 Furious
programme.desc: This sequel focuses on ex-police officer Brian O'Conner (Paul Walker), who relocates from Los Angeles to Miami to start over. Becoming involved in the street-racing scene in his new city, Brian befriends car-savvy Tej (Chris "Ludacris" Bridges) and Suki (Devon Aoki), but his competitive streak ends when federal agents apprehend him and he must enter into a deal with the FBI. Working with new partner Roman Pearce (Tyrese), Brian begins a dangerous mission to take down a powerful drug dealer.

programme.title: Timecop
programme.desc: When mankind perfects time travel, the government establishes the Time Enforcement Commission to thwart criminal attempts to alter the timeline.
